{{Top|leg}}
'''TradeCo, Incorporated''' was a localized transport company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. The company was best known for moving foodstuffs throughout the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], using custom [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to make their deliveries.
